issues.where: the storm filling the globe, worst in the lower half above the collar (crops 2 and 5)
issues.what: -a's storm is a bright, glowing white blizzard lit warm from inside and full of fine bright sparks. -b's storm is a dull grey haze, and the lower globe shows regular parallel ring-shaped bands that look like a procedural texture, not snow
issues.fix: brighten the storm toward near-white with the warm interior light spreading through it, break up the regular banding into soft, uneven swirl, and bring back the dense field of small lit particles

issues.what: in -b the tree is crisp and fully clear, sitting in front of the storm with no veil and no streaks crossing it, so it looks pasted on. In -a even the fairly clear crown is softened by snow and has streaks running over it. -b also does not deliver its own settled line that more than half of the miniature is hidden
issues.fix: put the tree inside the storm: lay a veil of haze and streaks across the trunk and the lower crown, and leave only the star and the top of the crown clear

issues.where: the streaks in the liquid, upper globe and shoulder (crop 1)
issues.what: -a's streaks are thin, bright, warm-lit flecks with long motion trails. -b's are short, dark grey dashes against a light haze
issues.fix: turn the streaks into light, catching the interior and lamp light, with longer tangential trails along the swirl

issues.what: -a's trunk is thick, dark, gnarled bark that flares into roots. -b's is thinner, smoother and copper-orange, with lights wound along the branches
issues.fix: widen the trunk and darken it to deep brown, gnarled bark with a root flare, and keep the lights in the crown

issues.where: the front edge of the snow inside the globe, above the collar (crop 5)
issues.what: in -a the front of the interior snow breaks into feathery frost fronds against the glass. In -b it is a smooth, rounded slab with a clean lip
issues.fix: break the front edge into frost fronds and soft drifts that meet the glass

issues.what: -b's door is orange-red where -a's is brown wood, and the fence is orange where -a's is dark, weathered wood. -b adds snow-capped shrubs at the front and has a thinner roof of snow. -b also loses the ivy on the left wall and the cottage sits slightly larger
issues.fix: darken the door and fence to brown wood, thicken the roof snow, bring back the ivy on the left wall and drop the extra shrubs

issues.where: the snow on the collar and the wood of the base (crops 4 and 5)
issues.what: -b's rim snow is a thin, flat sheet with crisp edges where -a's is heavy and clumpy. -b's wood is lighter, satin-finished and dusted with glitter, where -a's is dark, polished and clean
issues.fix: pile the rim snow up into uneven clumps, darken the wood and remove the glitter from it

issues.what: -a has a raised neck ring with visible glass thickness. -b has a flat oval disc
issues.fix: model a short raised collar ring at the top with a thick, bright rim

issues.where: the surface around the base and the mirror image (crop 6)
issues.what: -b's surface snow is flatter fern frost with glitter, where -a's is heaped thicker. -b's mirror image of the gold rope band is fainter
issues.fix: heap the surface snow a little higher, especially on the left, and strengthen the reflection of the gold base in the glossy surface

issues.what: -b is slightly cooler and more teal, with lifted shadows and a clean rendered sheen. -a is warmer and deeper, with a photographic softness
issues.fix: warm the grade slightly, deepen the blacks and add a touch of photographic softness
